newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Mid Wits to buy remaining 20 pct of Nico JV.
newsitem.headline: Mid Wits to buy remaining 20 pct of Nico JV.

text.p: Middle Witwatersrand (Western Areas) Ltd (Mid Wits) said on Wednesday it would buy the remaining 20 percent of the Nico Joint Venture from Eastern Transvaal Consolidated Mines Ltd (ET Cons) for 70 million rand.

In a joint statement, Anglovaal Ltd and Mid Wits said the purchase followed cautionary announcements on May 17 and August 27 regarding the reorganisation by Anglovaal of its mining and mineral interests.
Mid Wits already owns an 80 percent interest in the Nico project which in turn owns a 75 percent in the Nkomati Joint Venture, a base metals development project in Mpumalanga province.
Shareholders were advised to continue exercising caution in their share dealings.

Further to the reorganisation of Anglovaal, Saturn, a subsidiary of Mid Wits had disposed of its entire business to a partnership consisting of Mid Wits, Anglovaal and Industrial and Commercial Holdings Group Ltd, the statement said.
The percentage interests of the partners were identical to their shareholdings in Saturn, namely 65.6 percent, 21.9 and 12.5 respectively.

In respect of its 50 percent share of the profits of the Venetia Diamond Mine, the Saturn partnership had received a royalty from De Beers Consolidated Mines Ltd of 231.1 million rand for the six months to June 30. This compared to 58.4 million rand received in the corresponding period last year.
It was anticipated that the terms of the reorganisation of Anglovaal's mining and mineral interests would be announced before the end of September, the statement said.
